label: Record Review
description: Records the decision of the user task just before it as a review of the approval requirement named, by whoever completed that task, tagged with the task's outcome and carrying their note as a comment. Nothing may come between the two, neither a join nor a timer.

requirement.label: Requirement
requirement.description: The name of the approval requirement the decision answers, among those the submission's schema version asks, e.g. "approval".
